rawEvidence.contents: root context record plus normalized implementer and evaluator final reports

orchestrationEvents.event: Initial read-only BASE..CANDIDATE preflight used an unquoted PowerShell range and stopped before evaluator worktree creation.
orchestrationEvents.handling: Passed the range as one explicit string.

orchestrationEvents.event: Evaluator worktree creation succeeded, but the combined status reporter called Trim on an empty detached-branch value.
orchestrationEvents.handling: Kept the existing worktree and performed a separate readback.

orchestrationEvents.handling: Used the already verified pre-integration diff and separately read back HEAD, tree, and clean status.

limitations: This is one synthetic deterministic ticket, not a real product-quality or efficiency evaluation.
The evaluator used the same model family, filesystem, and tool permissions; context separation is not organizational independence or a security boundary.
Candidate-change invalidation, failed-criterion rework, the one-rework ceiling, and USER_DECISION escalation were not exercised end to end.
Implicit Ticket routing, personal installation discovery, and cross-project behavior remain unverified.
Agent final reports were retained in a normalized Markdown record; full tool-event streams and complete terminal stdout were not.
